findings.issue: The variable 'item' is an ISymbol (representing either a field or a property), so passing it to GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(IPropertySymbol) will cause a compiler error (CS1503).

For record properties and fields, GetSyntax() returns a ParameterSyntax or VariableDeclaratorSyntax respectively, so 'as PropertyDeclarationSyntax' evaluates to null. This causes valid diagnostics for source-declared members to be silently dropped by ReportIfLocatedInCompilation.
